items.en: "Sorry, no."
"There's a big cache on the other side of the system. My hold's full, so it's all yours."
"There's nothing here. Why stay?"
"I think it's time for you to go. I insist."
"Why are you lingering near the Gate?"
"It sure looks like you're watching the Gate. Expect something to come out?"
"I don't recall giving you my name."
"Who are you working for?"
"I'm going to need you to move away from the Gate."
"Risks?"
"So this would reopen the Gate network?"
"Well..."
"The Provost is right, I am more of a big-picture type leader."
"Academician, what exactly does 'chaotic' mean in this context?"
"The... manifold. Of course."
"Should I be worried about this Janus prototype?"
"What's going on?"
Use the Janus prototype on the Gate
"There was some kind of accident."
"You tell me what happened! I could have been killed by that thing!"
"I've seen worse. What's plan B?"
"I understand. Baird can be a bit assertive."
"I got out. I always do."
"Easy for you to say- I could have been killed!"
"Yes, you definitely owe me for this."
"I know."
"No, not especially."
"Can you elaborate on 'sorta-prisoner?'"
"Kanta, as in the pirate warlord Kanta?"
"Gargoyle, I feel like you know something about what's going on."
"What do you mean by 'another' Zal scheme?"
"How do we get Zal out?"
"Is 'hot' good?"
"So Kanta wants something found and returned. I could do that."
"We're going to need a better plan than 'ask nicely'."
"Credits could help. How much are we talking about?"
"I'll just make it up as I go along. Intuition hasn't failed me yet."
"Why not just shoot my way in and bust Zal out?"
"A quick strike and it'll be over before you know it."
"Sure. What's your point?"
"Keep your credits. We'll come up with something else."
"Every credit helps. Send 'em over."
"Can you get me any kind of tactical advantage? Security codes?"
"I am no thief. I come openly, having taken this prize from your kin."
"I'll waste no time. I'm here for Elissa Zal."
"My services. In exchange for Elissa Zal."
"What does the warlord desire?"
"My payment will be Zal."
"It's a deal."
"I'm going to need some kind of guarantee."
"I'd like to discuss additional terms."
"I don't agree to these terms."
Prepare a raid to extract Elissa Zal
"Tactical, what are our options?"
"Security- toss the Loke clone out an airlock. With a helmet."
"Security- toss the Loke clone out an airlock."
Tell Baird about your plan to meet Warlord Kanta
Tell Baird about the mission you are doing for Warlord Kanta
Prepare a raid to extract Clone Loke
"Nav, get us out of here."
"I need to find someone kidnapped by Brother Cotton."
"I'm looking for someone who is a... guest of Brother Cotton."
"I'll pay you good credits to know where to find Brother Cotton."
"I wish to speak with Brother Cotton. Can you help?"
"Let him know that I'll meet... him... there."
"Perhaps our paths should not cross just yet."
"Are you offering to arrange a meeting?"
"Tell Cotton I'll meet him there."
"Perhaps our paths should not cross just yet."
"Evening, friends. Next round on me?"
"Any of you happen to know Brother Cotton?"
"Looks like I was just leaving..."
"I'm here to talk. Cotton will know me."
"And here I thought Ludd taught a religion of peace."
Simply nod to your guards
"Just tell Cotton I'm here. I'll wait."
"I meant no offense. I just wish to see your boss."
"Mind yourself- I can have this place razed from orbit with a word."
Stare him down
"I'll wait here."
"I'll be back shortly."
"Server, a pot of tea please!"
"Server, a round for the large gentlemen over there!"
Go to the back room
Don't go to the back room just yet.
Don't go to the back room

Sit
Remain standing
"I know to never turn my back on a Pather."
"Did you not send a rogue Luddic Knight to kill me?"
"Despite hired killers coming for you, you meet me with tea. Why?"
"What do you even want with the Loke clone, if he's so ungodly?"
"So what are you going to do with the clone?"
"Kanta didn't explicitly ask me to kill you. Nor did Cydonia."
"Why is this clone so important to Kanta?"
"You're just going to give me Loke?"
"I wish to take the Loke clone back to Kanta. As I agreed."
"I'm taking the Loke clone."
"I want an explanation."
"Yes. I seek to follow the teachings of the Prophet Ludd."
"Is that offer open?"
"Credits or not, you sent the knight to kill me."
"Yes, funny how these things work out."
"Mercurial or not, you sent someone to kill me."
"And what significance is that?"
"This seems uncharacteristically non-violent."
"Did you realize that you cannot best me in combat?"
"I suppose you have better things for them to die for?"
"And Kanta?"
"This is unexpected."
Enter the shuttle
Return to orbit
"Loke, do you want to go back to Kanta?"
"Loke, do you want to stay here?"
"Loke, do you want to be free?"
"Yes. A shuttle will take him stationside."
"I have Loke for you. But first, I want Zal."
"Now send me Zal."
"What is it you want, then?"
"That wasn't part of the deal, Kanta."
"You call yourself warlord? You're a small-time cheat and liar."
"Open the pod bay doors, ops."
"Nav, set course for the Magec Gate."
"This isn't going to be another Galatia incident, is it."
"Nav, just take us away from here."
"And then?"
"Hook up the Janus Device."
"Nav, activate the Janus Device and take us in."
"Zal, how do I know it isn't going to explode on me again?"
"We're not done in the Magec system."
"Let's get on with it."
"You know Provost Baird will never let you go, right?"
"Scylla will be glad to see you."
"And this time it'll work?"
"Great plan. You almost blew me up before."
"We have a lot to talk about."
Access executive control
"Planning something?"
"Is it Coureuse?"
Sneak a glass of the victory spirit while you still can
"It looks like my work here is done."
"I truly believe in your project. I would not betray you."
"You got what you wanted, didn't you?"
"History doesn't always turn out the way you expected."
"'You reap what you sow.' Didn't Ludd say that?"
"So. About getting paid."
"I do believe that I was meant to be paid after this Janus business."
"Yes?"
"Come on, out with it."
"I couldn't have done it without you."
"Yeah. Don't mention it."
"The provost seemed a bit upset last we spoke."
"You've done a good job, Alviss. We did some great things together."
"I don't see how you're so loyal, the way Baird treats everyone."
"Maybe we should talk about something else."
"They don't need to be."
"This is true."
"Let's talk about something else."
"So Baird hasn't thrown you over to the Hegemony yet?"
"Is that it?"
"Nice to meet you, Academician."
"Shall we get on with it?"
"Not right now."
"Maybe next time."
"Could you help me set up a scholarship trust for promising students?"
"Baird told me to talk to you about setting up a scholarship..."
"Let's talk about setting up a scholarship again..."
"I'll give 100,000 credits. For our future."
"Double it, 200,000 credits."
"Can you do 500,000 credits?"
"Ah, interesting. Perhaps another time?"
"I wish to help those who cannot afford to attend the Academy on their own."
"Space exploration, to recover old knowledge and discover new."
"I want to promote AI research, as a powerful tool for humanity to use."
"I want to promote AI research, as a partnership between conscious minds."
"Study of the Luddic Word so students will remember their connection to Creation."
"The Gate system. We need to recover what was lost."
"Weapons research. And I want results I can exploit as soon as possible."
"How about a mission?"
